title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
abstract: arXiv:2609.13356v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this work, we present ZGCM-1, a fully open 7B dense foundation model trained from scratch with extreme data, system, and algorithmic efficiency. ZGCM-1 is founded on a core premise: compact models cannot passively memorize the open web, but can overcome parametric capacity limits by coupling deliberate internal thinking with active external tool use. To support this paradigm across a 256K context, we develop an end-to-end, high-efficiency open training recipe: Architecture & System Co-design: interleaved gated sliding-window and full attention, and a stable FP8 Muon optimizer; Progressive Curriculum & MDP Mid-Training: context scaling across 16K, 64K, and 256K, and the reformulation of interaction traces into Markov Decision Processes. Furthermore, we establish an AI-native R&D workflow where agent swarms autonomously manage cluster operations, data curation, and rapid diagnostic evaluation. translated_title: ZGCM-1：一个面向数学与智能体搜索的全开源、极致高效基础模型
translated_abstract: 在这项工作中，我们提出了ZGCM-1，一个完全开源的7B稠密基础模型，该模型从零开始训练，具备极致的数据、系统和算法效率。ZGCM-1建立在一个核心前提之上：紧凑型模型无法被动地记忆开放网络，但可以通过将深思熟虑的内部思考与主动的外部工具使用相结合来克服参数容量的限制。为了在256K上下文中支持这一范式，我们开发了一套端到端的高效开源训练方案：架构与系统协同设计——采用交错的门控滑动窗口注意力与全注意力机制，以及稳定的FP8 Muon优化器；渐进式课程与MDP中期训练——在16K、64K和256K范围内进行上下文扩展，并将交互轨迹重新表述为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）。此外，我们建立了一种AI原生的研发工作流程，其中智能体集群自主管理集群运维、数据策展和快速诊断评估。大量评估表明，ZGCM-1-7B……
tldr: ZGCM-1是一个全开源的7B基础模型，通过架构与系统协同设计、渐进式上下文扩展训练以及AI原生的智能体研发工作流，以极致效率实现了将内部深思与外部工具使用相结合的数学与智能体搜索能力。
en_tdlr: ZGCM-1 is a fully open 7B foundation model that achieves extreme efficiency in math and agentic search by coupling deliberate internal thinking with active tool use, enabled through architecture-system co-design, progressive context-scaling training, and AI-native agent-driven R&D workflows.
